monitored_text: Do you provide design support? What are your lead times? What file formats do you accept? Can you handle validation and testing? Yes. Our team advises on parting lines, draft, and material selection to get the most life out of each silicone tool. Silicone tool build and first castings typically ship within [CONFIRM] business days of a finalized master pattern. We typically work with STL, STEP, and IGES files, and our engineering team can accommodate most common CAD formats. Yes. We provide material data sheets, dimensional inspection, and production validation support as programs scale toward injection molding.
